applicable_when: The kernel performs a batched matmul over 32,768 independent (64x64)x(64x64) tiles but launches only grid=(1,1,1). A single CTA on one SM processes all 32,768 batch elements sequentially. The GPU has 132 SMs sitting completely idle. NCU's top rule (LaunchConfiguration, 99.24% speedup) confirms this is the dominant bottleneck. The fix is a persistent kernel: launch exactly num_sms=132 CTAs, each looping over ceil(32768/132)=249 batch tiles. This fills all 132 SMs and eliminates the sequential bottleneck. Reducing BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N from 64 to 32 also cuts register pressure from 121 to ~60 regs/thread, raising theoretical occupancy from 25% to ~50%.
